name: Wallet Pass Generator for Gravity Forms
author: sflwa

sections.description:
A secure, dynamic solution for generating cross-platform Apple Wallet and Android Wallet (.pkpass) passes from Gravity Forms entries. This plugin allows administrators to map form fields and Gravity Forms merge tags directly to standard PassKit generic pass slots—including Header, Primary, Secondary (1–4), Auxiliary (1–4), Back fields, GPS Locations, and QR Barcodes.

Designed for both developers and non-technical administrators, Version 2.0.0 introduces a sticky side-by-side Pass Blueprint builder, paired [Small Label | Main Value] slot cards, a live pass.json inspector, automatic @1x/@2x image scaling, and the SFLWA Support Panel.

Configuration

  1. Global Settings: Navigate to Forms > Settings > Wallet Pass. Enter your Apple Team ID, Pass Type ID, and the absolute server path to your .p12 certificate file (plus password). Use the SFLWA Support Panel on this screen for quick access to diagnostics and support resources.
  2. Form Setup: Open a specific Gravity Form and navigate to Settings > Wallet Pass.
  3. Top Bar & Lock Screen Triggers: Optionally configure logoText, the Top-Right Header slot (supports plain text or automatic local-to-UTC date/time conversion), and decimal Venue Latitude, Longitude, and Lock Screen Arrival Message (relevantText).
  4. Front of Pass Slots: Map paired [Small Label | Main Value] cards for Primary, Secondary (up to 4 columns), and Auxiliary (up to 4 columns) using text or Gravity Forms merge tags. Click any slot on the sticky Pass Blueprint to jump directly to its card.
  5. Colors, Images & Back of Pass: Optionally set custom Background, Foreground, and Label colors, specify paths for logo.png and thumbnail.png (automatically scaled proportionally to Apple’s @1x and @2x dimensions), and add Back of Pass details.
  6. QR Code: Enter a URL, entry ID, or merge tag string in the QR Code Message field to embed a scannable QR barcode on the pass.
  7. Delivery: Insert the {wp4gf_download_link} merge tag into your Gravity Forms confirmations or email notifications.

Troubleshooting

Common Error: OpenSSL “invalid key length” or “unsupported”

If you see this error on modern hosting (like SiteGround), it means your .p12 file is using older encryption that OpenSSL 3.x rejects by default. The plugin attempts to auto-convert legacy .p12 files automatically; if server permissions prevent automatic conversion, perform the “2-Step Legacy to Modern AES” conversion on your Mac Terminal:

  1. Unpack the original file (requires your Keychain password):
    openssl pkcs12 -in YourCert.p12 -nodes -out temp.pem

  2. Repack it using Modern AES-256 encryption:
    openssl pkcs12 -export -in temp.pem -out YourCert_Fixed.p12 -certpbe AES-256-CBC -keypbe AES-256-CBC -macalg SHA256

  3. Upload YourCert_Fixed.p12 to your server and update the password in settings.

Error: “Could not find private key”

This occurs if you only exported the Certificate from Keychain Access.
Fix: In Keychain Access, click the arrow (▶) next to the certificate to reveal the Private Key. Highlight BOTH items before selecting “Export”.

Thank You

Thank you to WebCami for your support of my work.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure your Apple .p12 certificate is uploaded via the built-in Upload Helper or placed in the secure directory: wp-content/uploads/wp4gf/.
sections.faq:
How do I provide the pass to my users?

Use the {wp4gf_download_link} merge tag in your Gravity Forms confirmations or email notifications.

Does this work on both iPhone and Android?

Yes. The plugin outputs standard PassKit generic .pkpass files without proprietary iOS-only extensions, so passes open natively in Apple Wallet on iOS/macOS as well as .pkpass-compatible Android wallet apps (such as PassWallet, WalletPasses, and Pass2U Wallet).

Why is a slot not showing on my pass?

Check the Inspect Generated pass.json panel below the Pass Blueprint preview on your form’s Wallet Pass settings page. If a merge tag evaluates to blank on your sample entry (for example, due to conditional form logic), combine multiple conditional merge tags in the value box so whichever field is populated renders automatically.

Do I need to manually resize my logo?

No. When PHP GD is enabled on your server, uploaded logos are automatically scaled proportionally to fit within Apple’s 160x50 (@1x) and 320x100 (@2x) bounds with transparency preserved so wide logos never overlap header fields.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Cross-Platform Generic PassKit Structure: Standardized pass generation on Apple’s generic PassKit template (headerFields, primaryFields, secondaryFields 1–4, auxiliaryFields 1–4, backFields, locations, and barcodes) for full iOS and Android wallet compatibility.
  • Sticky Split-Screen Pass Blueprint: Redesigned Form Settings with a sticky live Pass Blueprint preview, clickable slot highlighting, and paired [Small Label | Main Value] slot cards.
  • Live pass.json Inspector & Latest-Entry Sample Pass: Added a collapsible pass.json payload inspector and latest-entry sample pass download button directly in Form Settings.
  • Automatic @1x & @2x Image Resizing: Added proportional PHP GD image scaling for logo.png (160x50 / 320x100), icon.png (38x38 / 76x76), and thumbnail.png (90x90 / 180x180) with alpha transparency preserved.
  • GPS Geofencing & Arrival Alerts: Added decimal Venue Latitude, Longitude, and Lock Screen Arrival Message (relevantText) support with direct numeric coordinate handling.
  • Local-to-UTC Date Formatting: Added optional Date/Time toggle for the Header slot using the WordPress site timezone, automatically setting relevantDate.
  • SFLWA Support Panel: Added the SFLWA Support Panel to the plugin settings screen for quick access to documentation, diagnostics, and support.
  • OpenSSL 3 Auto-Conversion: Added automatic fallback conversion for legacy-encrypted Apple .p12 certificates on OpenSSL 3 servers.

1.7.9

  • Security Hardening: Implemented WPCS-compliant file validation, sanitization, and output escaping.
  • Modular Architecture: Refactored settings into dedicated Global and Form-specific classes for better stability.
  • Smart Asset Handling: Enhanced PKPass Factory with automatic URL-to-Path conversion for logos and icons.
  • Enhanced Diagnostics: Added real-time “Readability Status” indicators for certificate paths in Global Settings.
  • UI Refinement: Restored Live Preview with localized JS variables and simplified the visual asset fields.
  • Logic Update: Implemented conditional Auxiliary field display based on QR code presence.
  • Jump in Version Number is due to development offline and refactoring.

1.2.4

  • Enforced Primary field as a required setting.
  • Added conditional logic to hide optional fields if labels are empty.

1.2.3

  • Updated Preview CSS for vertical field alignment.
  • Implemented white-background and black-border styling for the admin preview.

1.2.2

  • Converted Back Field to a textarea for multi-line support and merge tag compatibility.

1.2.1

  • Major UI overhaul: Replaced dynamic mapping table with fixed, individual field sections for better stability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
